name: l10nization
description: A tool for extracting text to arb files in a Flutter application.

l10nization.haveMetadatas.markdownDescription: If enabled, add inputBox for description.

l10nization.haveDescription.markdownDescription: If enabled, add inputBox for description.

l10nization.copyMetadataInAllFiles.markdownDescription: If enabled, metadata are copied to all files, otherwise only to the `template-arb-file`.

l10nization.flutterPubGetEnabled.markdownDescription: If enabled, run the `flutter.task.genl10n` command of the [Dart extension](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=Dart-Code.dart-code).

l10nization.generationEnabled.markdownDescription: If enabled, run the `flutter.task.genl10n` command of the [Dart extension](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=Dart-Code.dart-code).

l10nization.arbSort.markdownDescription: If enabled, sort keys alphabetically except for `@@locale` is first and `@key` are below their `key`.

l10nization.organizeOnSave.markdownDescription: If enabled and editing arb files manually, when saving runs sort if enabled and formats file

l10nization.addNewMessagesIn.markdownDescription: `all` copy in each files, `template` copy only in `template-arb-file`

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run check-lint
scripts.check-lint-format: npm run check-lint && npm run check-format
scripts.lint-format: npm run lint && npm run format
